The '''75th [[Writers Guild of America Awards]]''' were held on March 5, 2023, to honor the best writing in film, television and radio of 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/writers-guild-awards-2023-winners-list-1235340028/ |title=WGA Awards: 'Everything Everywhere' Wins for Original Screenplay, 'Women Talking' Takes Adapted |last1=Lewis |first1=Hilary |last2=Chuba |first2=Kirsten |date=March 5, 2023 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=March 10, 2023 |archive-date=March 6, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230306075504/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/writers-guild-awards-2023-winners-list-1235340028/ |url-status=live }}</ref> The nominees for television and radio were announced on January 11, 2023, while the nominees for the film categories were announced on January 25, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2023/01/wga-awards-tv-nominations-2023-list-1235218393/ |title=WGA Awards TV Nominations: 'Abbott Elementary,' 'Better Call Saul,' 'The Crown,' 'Severance', 'Yellowjackets' Among Shows Vying for Top Prizes |last=Pedersen |first=Erik |date=January 11, 2023 |website=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |access-date=January 13, 2023 |archive-date=January 11, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111191729/https://deadline.com/2023/01/wga-awards-tv-nominations-2023-list-1235218393/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.wgaeast.org/22766-2/ |title=75th Annual Writers Guild Awards: 2022-2023 Media Timeline |date=September 6, 2022 |publisher=[[Writers Guild of America, East]] |access-date=January 13, 2023 |archive-date=April 16, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230416162628/https://www.wgaeast.org/22766-2/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

The ceremony was hosted by American actress and comedian [[Janelle James]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=MacCary |first1=Julia |last2=Reul |first2=Katie |last3=Flam |first3=Charna |date=2023-02-17 |title='Abbott Elementary' Star Janelle James to Host Writers Guild Awards (TV News Roundup) |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/abbott-elementary-janelle-james-host-wga-awards-1235525423/ |access-date=2023-02-17 |website=Variety |language=en-US |archive-date=2023-02-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230217003953/https://variety.com/2023/tv/news/abbott-elementary-janelle-james-host-wga-awards-1235525423/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
